label: Lamassu-Lipase system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder Lamassu-Lipase subtype locus represented by the Lamassu-Lipase rule row requiring the Lamassu-Fam__LmuA_effector_Lipase and Lamassu-Fam__LmuB_SMC_Cap4_nuclease_II profiles.
observations: Lamassu-Lipase branch under Lamassu system; distinct from the broader Lamassu system, other Lamassu-Fam rule subtypes, individual LmuA, LmuB, or LmuC proteins, SMC-family ATPases, lipase activities, LmuABC complexes, dsDNA-end binding, exact phage triggers, native host breadth, unresolved lipase substrates, LmuC requirement, unresolved cell-death outputs, DefenseFinder HMM rows, and other phage-defense systems.
